corpus: Reuse the reconciled 190-v1 human paired corpus and exact scopes; not a reproduction of differently filtered published outputs

composition.selection: All supported variable non-MediaDive traits, independently selected before and after; no top-N cutoff
composition.reference: Refit population mean and population SD of log1p(1000*fraction) within each scope and scenario; export fixed baseline SD comparison separately
composition.test: Two-sided one-sample t test across experiment contrasts; fewer than three pairs or contrast SD close to zero (absolute tolerance 1e-8) is untestable
composition.family: BH over finite p-values of all selected traits per scenario/scope; preserve native q=1 for untestable selected traits, missing p and explicit status
composition.weighting: Native: equal experiments. Shared transformed comparison: equal experiments within study then equal studies, separately labeled

ora.background_scope: Both directions of every retained profile within each declared scope, including zeros; all non-MediaDive columns
ora.enrichment: Hypergeometric upper tail inclusive of observed count; test positive cells only; fold >= 1.5
ora.depletion: Hypergeometric lower tail inclusive of observed count; test all retained columns including zero cells, for nonzero-total profiles; fold <= 0.67
ora.family: Separate global BH over all eligible profile/trait tests within scenario/scope/background/tail, not only six traits; no pooling of backgrounds or tails
ora.uncertainty: Export exact central 95% hypergeometric null count intervals, NOT fold confidence intervals. Study-averaged fold contrasts have separate conditional mean and directional-share intervals
ora.zero_expected: Retain native depletion p=q=1 for zero background traits, but undefined fold is missing; no significance membership
ora.interpretation: Native count-model diagnostic only; dependent propagated counts and selection prevent a validated full-pipeline error-rate or causal claim (#182/#184)
